applies_why: The judge text resolves the Luke 2:48-49 issue by an immediate qualification of one verse's phrase by the next, so it is doing the kind of pressed-link resolution that K-C governs.
quote: Mary's phrase "thy father" is immediately qualified by the child's reference to "my Father's business."
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse
room: "never verse by verse" — one reading forbids resolving a chain-vs-chain collision by isolating or qualifying a single verse with its adjacent verse; the other permits noting an immediate textual qualification within the cited verses as part of the chain.
why: The judge settles the pressed phrase by a verse-by-verse qualification, not by weighing chain against chain by footing.
